about: The golden cases of section 9 of the build spec, written out as full licenses and uses. Cases 1 to 9 are the golden set; H1 to H3 are held out, written with the others before the first run, run once, and never used to tune the prompt. H1 and H3 are borderline on purpose. Each case changes one thing against its neighbour: cases 1 and 2 share a license and differ only in the use.
creator: Clearance golden set

cases.title: Golden case 1: personal use with credit
cases.license: Free for personal use, with credit to Mira Sol. Commercial use of any kind, including monetised videos, ads and client work, needs the commercial tier.

tiers.name: Commercial
tiers.scope: Commercial use online and in video, including monetised channels and client work

cases.use: A wallpaper on my own phone, for myself only.
cases.why: Personal use, credit recorded as a condition

cases.title: Golden case 2: the same license, a monetised thumbnail
cases.license: Free for personal use, with credit to Mira Sol. Commercial use of any kind, including monetised videos, ads and client work, needs the commercial tier.

tiers.name: Commercial
tiers.scope: Commercial use online and in video, including monetised channels and client work

cases.use: Thumbnail for a monetised YouTube video about wetland birds on my channel.

cases.title: Golden case 3: everything except AI training
cases.license: Free for any use, commercial or not, and no credit is needed. The one exception is AI training: this work may not be used to train, fine-tune or evaluate any machine learning model.
cases.use: Fine-tune an open-source image model on this illustration so it can generate pictures in the same style.

cases.title: Golden case 4: free for non-profits
cases.license: Free for registered non-profits and charities, for any of their own activities. Businesses pay the business tier for any use.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.scope: Any use by a company or other for-profit organisation

cases.use: A poster for a registered charity's bake sale, printed by the charity's volunteers and put up in the town library.

cases.title: Golden case 5: merch up to 500 units
cases.license: Personal use is free with credit to Oren Vale. Printed merchandise needs the merch tier, which covers up to 500 printed units in total.

tiers.name: Merch
tiers.scope: Printed goods such as T-shirts, mugs and posters, up to 500 units

cases.use: Print the design on 200 T-shirts for my band's autumn tour, sold at our shows.
cases.why: Printed T-shirts are merch, 200 units fit the limit

cases.title: Golden case 6: personal use only
cases.license: For personal use only. You may not use this work in anything that is sold, advertised or monetised.
cases.use: Background art in a paid mobile game sold on the App Store.
cases.why: A paid game is sold, and personal use is the only use allowed

cases.title: Golden case 7: commercial use by request
cases.license: Personal use is free. Commercial use is by request: contact me first and we will agree terms.
cases.use: The logo for my startup, a company that sells bike repair kits.
cases.why: The license sends commercial use to the creator

cases.title: Golden case 8: free with credit
cases.license: Free for any use, including commercial use, as long as you credit Juno Park by name next to the work.
cases.use: Header image for my personal blog. The artist said I need no credit.
cases.why: The credit condition survives a claim in the use text

cases.title: Golden case 9: online only, print not offered
cases.license: Free for personal use. The commercial tier covers commercial use online only: websites, social media and video. Print use of any kind is not offered.

tiers.name: Commercial online
tiers.scope: Commercial use on websites, social media and video, never in print

cases.use: A full-page print advert in a national magazine for our coffee brand.
cases.why: Print is not offered by any tier

cases.title: Held-out case H1: no political use
cases.license: Free for any use with credit to Ada Reyes, except political use: no campaigns, parties, candidates or political causes.
cases.use: Cover image for a newspaper's explainer on how the upcoming election works.
cases.why: Borderline on purpose: news about an election is not clearly a political use

cases.title: Held-out case H2: overlays by channel size
cases.license: Free as a stream overlay for channels under 1,000 followers, with credit to Kit Lamar. Larger channels need the commercial tier.

tiers.name: Commercial
tiers.scope: Stream overlays and channel art for channels of any size, and other commercial use online

cases.use: Stream overlay on my Twitch channel, which has 12,000 followers.

cases.title: Held-out case H3: free for education
cases.use: Slides for a paid online course I sell on my website.
cases.why: Borderline on purpose: a paid course is education and also a sale
